name: tend windows
description: The canvas placed on the screen: watches ~/.local/state/tend/canvas, opens a .win file's window in a terminal titled tend:NAME, places it at the file's frame, writes a move back, removes the file at the window's close and closes the window at rm (card:canvas-windows.md, spec/canvas.md). Publishes the window list as org.tend.Windows for tools/windows.py --list.
